paragraphs.text: Javenesh Stoutclaw is a second-year owlin student at Lorehold College in Strixhaven University. Known for his rugged appearance and physical strength, Javenesh is a prominent figure both on the Silkball field and behind the bar at Bow’s End Tavern.

Despite his intimidating build and perpetually disheveled appearance, Javenesh is a good-natured and approachable individual. His rough look — marked by scruffy plumage, scattered scars, and well-worn clothing — often leads others to misjudge him. In truth, Javenesh harbors a friendly disposition and simply wishes others would take the time to see past his gruff exterior.

He works as the assistant manager at Bow's End Tavern , where he oversees staff and maintains order with quiet authority. His sheer presence is often enough to deter troublemakers without needing to raise his voice. Off the job, Javenesh is a formidable athlete in the Intramural Silkball Club, where his charging figure is something most players would rather avoid.

Javenesh's reputation as a tough but fair presence on campus offers protection to those he considers friends. However, those who find themselves on his bad side may find their welcome wearing thin, especially at the tavern.
